admin.items_help: Drag the handles to reorder. The eye hides an item, the star highlights it, and the pencil renames it, changes its icon or limits it to certain groups. Items added by other extensions appear here on their own. The preview shows the result for any group before you save. Click Save Changes when done.
admin.scan_failed: Your forum's sidebar could not be read, so items from other extensions may be missing from this list. Reload the page to try again.
admin.drag_label: Drag to reorder {name} (or focus and press Alt + arrow keys)
admin.badge_invalid_url: Not shown: use a web address, mailto:, tel: or /path
admin.badge_missing: Not on the sidebar right now
admin.rename_help: Leave empty to keep the original name.
admin.url_help: A web address (example.com/page or https://…), a mailto: or tel: address, or a path on this forum such as /tags.
admin.icon_help: Any Font Awesome class, such as fas fa-fire. Leave empty for the default.
admin.groups_help: Tick groups to show this item only to them. With none ticked, everyone sees it.
admin.picker_more: Showing {shown} of {count} — search to narrow it down
admin.picker_none: No icons match. You can still type any Font Awesome class in the field.
admin.preview_empty: Nothing to show for this group.
admin.preview_failed: This group's sidebar couldn't be read, so items other extensions show only to some people may be listed here too.
admin.flip_label: Show tags above the menu items
admin.flip_help: Puts the tag list at the top of the sidebar, with All Discussions, Following and the rest beneath it.
admin.sticky_label: Keep the sidebar in view while scrolling
admin.sticky_help: The sidebar, including the Start a Discussion button, stays on screen as visitors scroll. Desktop only.
admin.highlight_color_help: The color of highlighted items. Leave empty to use your forum's primary color.
